Found a bug or experiencing a problem with Burnout 3 PAL Enhanced?

Report a bug — Report crashes, graphical glitches, performance issues and other technical problems.

Community Discussions — Ask questions, share feedback, suggest ideas or contact the project maintainer.

Project maintainer — JMPliskin — Visit my GitHub profile.

Please search existing issues before submitting a new report.

For bug reports, include your game version, operating system, hardware specifications, reproduction steps and relevant logs whenever possible.

Do not upload copyrighted game files, original executables, disc images or personal information.

This is a community-driven project developed in spare time. Responses and fixes cannot be guaranteed.
